<p dir="auto"><strong>What if you could access your favorite LLM from airplane WiFi without paying fees for internet?</strong></p>
<p dir="auto">This project exploits a fundamental oversight in network restrictions: while most traffic gets blocked until you authenticate or pay, DNS queries almost always work. That "Sign in to continue" page on airplane WiFi? It still needs DNS to load. This tool tunnels encrypted LLM conversations through that same DNS channel for free, unrestricted access.</p>
<p dir="auto">The technique, known as DNS tunneling, is an old school hack inspired by tools like <a href="https://github.com/yarrick/iodine">iodine</a>. This implementation adapts the classic approach for the AI era: masking your conversations as mundane DNS lookups, chunking and encrypting messages across multiple queries that sail right through captive portals, corporate firewalls, and network filters. Perfect for when you need AI access but the network wants your credit card first.</p>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Features</h2><a id="user-content-features" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Features" href="#features"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>End-to-end encryption</strong> using Fernet (AES-128) symmetric encryption</li>
<li><strong>DNS steganography</strong> - conversations hidden in normal-looking DNS queries</li>
<li><strong>Automatic chunking</strong> - handles message size limitations transparently</li>
<li><strong>Token streaming</strong> - receive LLM responses in real-time, chunk by chunk</li>
<li><strong>Session persistence</strong> - maintains conversation context across requests</li>
<li><strong>Multiple LLM providers</strong> - OpenAI, Ollama, or any OpenAI-compatible API (ie: vLLM, OpenRouter, etc)</li>
<li><strong>Web search integration</strong> - real-time information via Perplexity AI</li>
<li><strong>Production deployment</strong> - works anywhere DNS resolution is available</li>
<li><strong>Traffic camouflage</strong> - configurable DNS suffixes to blend with legitimate network traffic</li>
<li><strong>Simple architecture</strong> - client/server model with minimal dependencies</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">How It Works</h2><a id="user-content-how-it-works" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: How It Works" href="#how-it-works"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">The protocol works by encoding encrypted chat messages as DNS subdomain queries:</p>
<ol dir="auto">
<li><strong>Message encryption</strong>: Client compresses and encrypts message using Fernet symmetric encryption</li>
<li><strong>Chunking</strong>: Encrypted data is base36-encoded and split into DNS-compatible segments</li>
<li><strong>DNS encoding</strong>: Each chunk becomes a subdomain query with configurable suffix:

<p dir="auto">Deploy the server on your target machine:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Install on target server</span>
git clone <span class="pl-k"><</span>your-repo<span class="pl-k">></span>
<span class="pl-c1">cd</span> llm-dns-proxy
uv pip install -e <span class="pl-c1">.</span>

<span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Set environment variables</span>
<span class="pl-k">export</span> OPENAI_API_KEY=<span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>your-api-key<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>
<span class="pl-k">export</span> LLM_PROXY_KEY=<span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>your-encryption-key<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>

<span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Start server on port 53 (requires root/sudo)</span>

<p dir="auto">Ensure DNS traffic can reach your server:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Ubuntu/Debian with UFW</span>

sudo ufw allow 53/tcp

sudo firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=53/tcp

<span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Check if port is listening</span>

sudo firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=53/tcp
sudo firewall-cmd --reload

# Check if port is listening

<p dir="auto">Create a systemd service for automatic startup:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Create service file</span>
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/llm-dns-proxy.service <span class="pl-k">></span> /dev/null <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-k"><<</span><span class="pl-k">EOF</span></span>
<span class="pl-s">[Unit]</span>
<span class="pl-s">Description=LLM DNS Proxy Server</span>
<span class="pl-s">After=network.target</span>
<span class="pl-s"></span>
<span class="pl-s">[Service]</span>
<span class="pl-s">Type=simple</span>
<span class="pl-s">User=llm-proxy</span>
<span class="pl-s">WorkingDirectory=/opt/llm-dns-proxy</span>
<span class="pl-s">Environment=OPENAI_API_KEY=your-api-key-here</span>
<span class="pl-s">Environment=LLM_PROXY_KEY=your-encryption-key-here</span>
<span class="pl-s">Environment=PERPLEXITY_API_KEY=your-perplexity-api-key-here</span>
<span class="pl-s">ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/python -m llm_dns_proxy.cli server --host 0.0.0.0 --port 53</span>
<span class="pl-s">Restart=always</span>
<span class="pl-s">RestartSec=3</span>
<span class="pl-s"></span>
<span class="pl-s">[Install]</span>
<span class="pl-s">WantedBy=multi-user.target</span>
<span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-k">EOF</span></span>

<span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Enable and start service</span>
